name: iron vambraces
_design_note: F20-60 medium arms slot. Riveted plate from wrist to elbow. Covers iron_bracers, bronze_bracers, chain_bracers, scale_bracers from legacy data — material is the variation axis.
lore_template: Each of these {material_name} vambraces is a single curved plate, riveted about the forearm from wrist to elbow. The sergeants who drill young soldiers forbid them to block a blade with the arm, but in close fighting it happens for all that, and these are what save the arm.
